#en: Look who decided to drop by!
zh: 看看是谁决定来串门了！

#en: Not that it's my business, you look like you need medical attention.
zh: 虽说这不关我的事，但你看上去需要医疗处理。

#en: Scared of doctors or something? Go get yourself treated already!
zh: 怕医生还是怎么着？快去治治吧！

#en: You don't look so good. You should go to the med clinic.
zh: 你气色不太好。该去医疗站看看。

#en: You're in bad shape, you should visit Laine.
zh: 你伤势不轻，该去找莱恩。

#en: You should probably go see Dr. Laine, get that checked out.
zh: 你该去看看莱恩博士，把那个检查一下。
睁大眼睛！敌人就在附近！

#en: They might still be around. Keep looking!
zh: 他们可能还在附近。继续找！

#en: You picked a bad day to get lost!
We have no choice, ready for combat.

zh: 我们必须消除一切威胁。

#en: Stay sharp! They could be close by.
zh: 保持警觉！他们可能就在附近。

#en: We were in the middle of a fight! Rude.
zh: 我们正打得兴起呢！真没礼貌。
与敌人的接触已重新建立。

#en: Trying to ghost us, huh? Nice try.
zh: 想跟我们玩消失，是吧？想得美。

#en: Evidently, you can run, but you can't hide!
Calling it. Everyone back to your post!

zh: 取消搜索。这里什么都没有。
敌意活动未获确认。解除戒备。

#en: No threat? That's a pleasant surprise.
zh: 没有威胁？这可真让人惊喜。

#en: Looks like my instincts were off, this time.
zh: 看来这次我的直觉出错了。
嗯。我今天就是有点神经过敏。

#en: Heads up. Hostiles in the area!
All that tension, and now... nothing? Hmph.
zh: 那么紧张，结果现在……什么都没有？哼。
接近警报触发。正在调查。

#en: Potential danger identified. Please stand by.

zh: 感觉到了吗？有东西在附近潜行……
我的直觉说附近有麻烦。

#en: Phew! That got the blood pumping.
zh: 呼！这可真让人血脉贲张。

#en: Glad we didn't have to go all out.
zh: 幸好我们不必全力以赴。
我们毫发无伤地走开了。……大多是。

#en: Nice teamwork! Like a well-oiled machine.
zh: 配合得好！就像一台上了油的机器。
全部清空。目标早就跑了。

#en: Target must have fled the area.
zh: 目标一定已经逃离该区域。

#en: Enemy escaped. We'll get 'em next time.
zh: 敌人逃了。下次我们再收拾他们。
未检测到进一步敌意活动。
威胁等级极低。全部清空。

#en: Threat vanished. Returning to standard operations.
zh: 威胁消失。正在恢复标准运作。

#en: They bolted. Can't say I blame them.
zh: 他们开溜了。我不怪他们。

#en: If they show up again, we'll be ready.
zh: 如果他们再来，我们准备好了。

#en: Huh. They must've cut and run.
zh: 嗯。他们一定是吓得跑了。

#en: Retreat was their only viable option.
zh: 撤退是他们唯一可行的选择。
他们逃了。可以预见的反应。

#en: Looks like they lost their nerve.

zh: 护盾发射器离线。规避机动！

#en: Shield failure! Brace for hull impact.
zh: 护盾故障！准备承受船体冲击。
他们会击穿我们的护盾！

#en: That was the last of the shielding.
